# `gate` command

One verdict for a change: build, review, test, verify, diff-run, bench, assess and matrix as stages, each with its
first failing fact.

```bash
fobis gate [options]
```

How to use it, with examples: [Verifying results](/cookbook/verification), [CI and machine output](/cookbook/ci).

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT |  | Specify a "fobos" file named differently from "fobos" |
| `--fci` |  |  | Assume fobos inputs as case insensitive |
| `--mode` | TEXT |  | Select a mode defined into a fobos file |
| `--stage` | TEXT |  | Run only these stages (repeatable or comma-separated): build review test verify diff-run bench assess matrix. |
| `--skip` | TEXT |  | Stages not to run (repeatable). |
| `--advisory` | TEXT |  | Stages reported but not failing the gate (repeatable). |
| `--base` | TEXT |  | Compare with the merge base of HEAD and this revision [default: HEAD]. |
| `--fail-fast` |  |  | Stop at the first failing stage. |
| `--json` |  |  | Emit structured JSON to stdout instead of human-readable output (useful for scripting / agents) |

<!-- cli:end -->
